program_name: Women Entrepreneurship Strategy GBA+ Scoring Advantage
funder: Innovation Science and Economic Development Canada (ISED)
amount_notes: Not a direct grant program. Women Entrepreneurship Loan Fund delivers up to $50,000 loans through community delivery organizations — repayable. Direct WES grants are directed at NFP ecosystem organizations not individual businesses. Primary value is GBA+ scoring priority in mainstream programs.
organization_types_eligible: Women-owned businesses with 51% or greater female ownership and control
Canadian incorporated for-profit businesses with female majority ownership
eligibility_criteria: Business must be majority owned and controlled by women — minimum 51% female ownership
WES Ecosystem Fund — for NFP ecosystem support organizations only, not individual businesses
Women Entrepreneurship Loan Fund — delivered through community organizations up to $50K repayable
exclusions: WES direct grants are for NFP ecosystem organizations not individual for-profit businesses
Women Entrepreneurship Loan Fund is repayable — not a non-repayable grant
Adele Hills ownership stake as female founder must be confirmed at 51%+ for eligibility
notes: IMPORTANT CLARIFICATION: WES is not a single direct grant program. Of 40+ programs marketed as WES-aligned, only approximately 6 are true non-repayable grants, and these are primarily directed at NFP ecosystem organizations. The real value for Sacral Solutions is GBA+ (Gender-Based Analysis Plus) scoring priority in mainstream federal programs including NRC IRAP and PacifiCan BSP — being women-owned gives documented scoring advantage in competitive assessments. Adele Hills is inventor and COO. Confirm her ownership percentage exceeds 51% before positioning Sacral as women-owned for any application. WeBC (Womens Enterprise Centre BC) provides advisory services and loan guarantees in BC — not direct grants but useful for application support.
